newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Resources Development unit wins tender.
newsitem.headline: Resources Development unit wins tender.

text.p: Resources Development Corp Ltd (RDC) said on Thursday its joint venture company in Vietnam has award a contract worth US$21.65 million to Sembawang Construction Pte Ltd.
It said in a statement the tender was awarded for the construction of a 16-storey service apartment project in Ho Chih Minh City.
Sembawang Construction is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Sembawang Corp Ltd which is also a substantial shareholder of RDC.
The tender was awarded on the basis Sembawang Construction had submitted the lowest tender price and had complied with the terms and conditions of the tender, it said.
